overrides.reason: The probe's brand heuristic picks the leftmost interactive element inside the measured <header>, but AREA 17's brand mark is an oversized graphic that overflows the rail and is not among the header's interactive children. The probe therefore reports the first NAV LINK (x=942 at 1440) as the brand. evidence/area17/desktop-initial.png shows the actual mark at x=16, which is what the reconstruction renders.
